headline: Five-year contract with Waste Management of Londonderry, Inc. for curbside trash, recycling, and dumpster pickup, C-27-45.
summary: Contract C-27-45 covers curbside trash and recycling pickup, plus dumpster pickup at certain locations. The agenda lists annual and monthly rates for Years 1 through 5, from $2,689,790 annual in Year 1 to $3,269,461 annual in Year 5.
items: C-27-45: Waste Management of Londonderry, Inc., 1700 Westborough, MA 01581, for curbside trash and recycling, along with dumpster pick up at certain locations
location: Great Hall, Searles Building, 3rd. Floor, 41 Pleasant Street, Methuen, MA 01844
